description: Press a phone hardware button once: volume-up, volume-down, power, mute, sleep, wake, media-play-pause, media-next, media-previous, media-rewind, or media-fast-forward. The press is dispatched without activating the session app and nothing is re-observed afterwards, so the OS decides what the key does — which audio stream a volume press moves, which media session a media key reaches, and whether the HUD shows, is device behavior this command does not claim. Power toggles the Android screen; sleep and wake are the explicit Android events that turn it off or on without toggling, and after a press that turns it off, later commands may hit a locked screen. Android (ADB-backed and Appium) presses all eleven on phones and tablets; a physical iPhone or iPad presses volume only through the local runner or Appium, never power, mute, sleep, wake, or media. iOS Simulators, Android TV and tvOS targets refuse: on TV targets use tv-remote. Times out after 90s.

button.description: One press each. volume-up and volume-down move the system volume stream the OS selects; power toggles the screen on Android; sleep and wake are the explicit Android events that turn the screen off or on without toggling; mute, media-play-pause, media-next, media-previous, media-rewind, and media-fast-forward are Android keys the OS routes to its own streams and media sessions. All of these except volume are refused on every Apple leaf.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.
